bio.text: Adline Clarke is a Democratic member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 97, first elected in a special election on May 21, 2013.
According to her legislative profile, she majored in communication arts at Spring Hill College and is a former reporter and city editor for the Mobile Press-Register.
The profile says she retired in December 2017 as senior vice president of Mobile Development Enterprises and is a small business owner.
